title: Superstore Sales Dataset
transformations: Parse Order Date explicitly as DD/MM/YYYY
Aggregate Sales by calendar month, region and category
Count order lines; do not claim they are distinct orders
Exclude customer names, IDs, addresses and product-level details
unit: Sales in source currency units; source does not explicitly verify currency
caveat: Historical educational retail records from Kaggle; not current country or sector market-size estimates. No independent verification of authenticity.
